 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.105 of 2023 registered at Police Station Vijaypur, District Guna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 452, 366, 376 (2) (N), 120-B of IPC and Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant seeks for and is granted permission to withdraw this second anticipatory bail application with liberty to surrender and file regular bail application.

It is further Devendra Rajput vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90927805/
1 prayed that trial Court be directed to decide the regular bail application of the applicant as expeditiously as possible.
